diagnosis: The observability route queries distributed trace spans in Jaeger by trace_id. Because trace spans capture raw SQL queries, authorization tokens, and HTTP request bodies, failing to verify that the trace belongs to current_user.project_id permits arbitrary users to inspect confidential database queries and internal calls of other customers.
exploit_request:
GET /observability/traces/4bf92f3577b34da6a3ce929d0e0e4736/spans HTTP/1.1
Host: monitor.platform.net
Authorization: Bearer <regular_user_jwt>
